description: This file contains an extension of the CanvasWindowController class, specifically implementing WKNavigationDelegate methods to handle web view navigation decisions and actions within the app. It manages deep links, internal navigation, and external URL handling.

methods.name: webView(_:decidePolicyFor:decisionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles navigation actions in WKWebView, deciding whether to allow navigation, handle deep links, or open external URLs.

methods.name: webView(_:didFinish_:)
methods.description: Called when web view finishes navigation; triggers the application of debug status if needed.
